display_name: LoRa W24 去 chirp 后的跨 chirp 复谱修正
description: Jointly train a native spectral direction with a matched local endpoint and a peer-only attention contribution.
authorization: Active LoRa DURA performance research goal.

code.environment: N607 single admissible CUDA card, BF16 convolution on supported devices and FP32 masked attention; CPU truth-last.
code.cwd: Immutable release for GPU fitting; original W24 E104 release for post-freeze CPU smoke, prediction and scoring.

data.representation: Continuous 8192 complex samples at 1 MHz through DURA; untouched W24 front end receives the resulting packet.
data.physical_ids_ref: Original registered U_s practical trace bank and deterministic 4000 per receiver fit plus 500 independent held; frozen 300 same-ID source V panel.
data.label_map_ref: Original W24 frozen class mapping; target labels scorer only
data.validation_ref: Reuse VALIDATED_ONCE lora_full_packets_v1 registered V order and true E104.
data.leo_config_ref: Registered native Full clean and six practical views.

permissions.claim_scope: F-free, TX-blind source U_s fit; legal same-source received and pre-noise references. No V or target before freeze. CPU source truth-last after fixed source readouts.

checkpoint.initialization: Freeze verified same-contract Practical exact additive weight, initialize new peer spectral head at deterministic model seed 2026112991.

sources.role: Exact terminal frozen 24,000 update direction head and original optimizer budget.
Fixed source-only Practical exact-additive 24000 update checkpoint for both readouts.
Independent source evaluation after direction checkpoint freeze.
Only after new terminal freeze, three archived baseline predictions must match exactly.

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Exact r01 current terminal checkpoint, original parent, E104 readout, 300 source V IDs and endpoint parity.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen parent of the same LoRa source contract; original source-only checkpoint
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed 48,000-step EMA-free endpoint. Cross-chirp must exceed original frozen head by >=18 six, six paired lower bound >0, at least +6 low and not lower than within, preserve source direct clean and exceed within on six.

execution.gpu_policy: One available GPU under current shared training cap, priority 7,0,3,2,6,5. After freeze two-thread CPU inference, two replay workers.
execution.stop_rule: Mismatched source/weight bindings, nonfinite source check/training, baseline parity or blind closure/scorer error. Preserve existing healthy owner tasks and partial outputs.

dimensions: native Full; 300 same source V packets; seven views; five readouts; five source receivers

rows.method: One full-packet phase and IQ direction head with separate hard pre-RMS center and edge norms
rows.seed_notes: New source fit seed 2026112991; registered V panel and Full draw; independent E104 seed 2026092702.
rows.budget_ref: 48,000 updates, batch 16 with 2 identity records. Both paths scored jointly during each update. One terminal checkpoint.

notes: Use the same existing native receive frame, tracking and public chirp waveform. The within-chirp path has only local spectral tokens; the peer additional branch has self-masked cross-chirp attention at each aligned native FFT bin.
Both output native complex proposals at the same regional dose; the only hypothesis between two new readouts is including the jointly trained peer contribution.
Weights kept .35 within / .65 peer per both matching directional base, weak spectrum and identity objectives. Existing comparator is evaluated after freeze only.
